title: pinus holophylla
intro: Pinus holophylla, commonly known as Yunnan pine, is a species of evergreen tree native to China. This plant is known for its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which provide several health benefits, including reducing the risk of cardiovascular disease and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Pinus holophylla include its ability to inhibit the growth of certain microorganisms, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Pinus holophylla include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
